name: Ford - Ohio Assembly Plant, Avon Lake OH

fieldNotes.facility: Ohio Assembly Plant (Super Duty chassis cab, F-650/750 medium-duty, E-Series), 650 Miller Rd, Avon Lake OH. Geocode landed on the rooftop (moved 348m); confirmed as the large multi-roof assembly complex - ~3.7M sq ft of building on a 419-acre site (web-confirmed).
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED. A definitive truck gate with a guard shack is visible at z19/z20 on the west side: a square guard building with a central courtyard, multiple truck lanes splitting around it, gate canopies/arms over the lanes, and a wide paved staging apron upstream. Clear controlled checkpoint where the truck route meets the access road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: CONFIRMED. Distinct square multi-lane guard booth structure beside the truck lane at the west gate - classic staffed gatehouse footprint with windows on multiple sides and gate canopies.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer guarded truck gate plus internal vehicle-control checkpoints typical of an assembly plant of this scale.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail corridor runs along the east side of the campus with rail access into the plant; assembly plant of this scale relies on rail for inbound/outbound. Marked supported by the rail line visible east of the complex.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer drop yard on the NE side with dozens of trailers in organized rows, plus trailer rows near the west gate - separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible across the NE drop yard and dock faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~45 loading doors across the building faces and a long modern dock bank visible in Street View on the west side; estimate from overhead imagery - marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces plus a large modern dock building on the west side - shipping and receiving run from physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with multiple lanes splitting around the guard booth and substantial unused paved width - clear room for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large connected and separate buildings forming an integrated assembly campus, plus a large modern distribution/dock building on the west.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Avon Lake / Sheffield with farmland and woods on the west and a golf course to the north - per rubric, when torn between small-town industrial and Urban, choose Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is on the edge of a small town with farmland adjacent but within the Cleveland metro reach - cellular coverage likely adequate; false but flagged as inferred.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left uncertain.
